_note: Reversible defaults chosen by the builder. Replace with the approved grid-planning playbook values and record who approved them.

schedule.description: Monday, Wednesday and Friday at 06:00 America/New_York. Each run covers the 7 days ending the previous day.

chart.method: Individuals and moving-range (I-MR) chart on one value per day: the daily peak load
chart.limits_note: Control limits come from the transformer's own historical daily peaks, never from the rated maximum.

capability.method: One-sided Cpk (Cpu) against the rated maximum, sigma from the average moving range (MRbar/d2); 95% interval by Bissell's approximation with effective degrees of freedom 0.62 x (n-1) for the moving-range estimator
capability.uncertainty_note: Uncertain = the estimate is at or above the threshold but the lower 95% bound is below it.
capability.assumption_note: Cpk is reported only when daily peaks pass a lag-1 autocorrelation check (+/- 2/sqrt(n)) and a Jarque-Bera normality test; otherwise the case goes to review.

forecast.allocation_note: When a transformer's location falls in more than one boundary area, use the primary area declared on the asset record and flag the assumption for the reviewer.
forecast.unit_note: Forecast demand is real power (kW per heat pump). Readings and ratings in kVA are apparent power; added kW is divided by power_factor before it is added. Assets rated in kW are added directly.
